name: – Niclas Herbst – After § 18 – Am 42
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 18b. Notes with concern that the Court, in its Special Report 11/2025, found that the transparency in Union funding to NGOs remains insufficient due to the Commission’s failure to verify key aspects, such as whether self-declared NGOs were in fact pursuing the commercial interests of their members;
